Name: Farm Cave Framework
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a framework mod that lets you use Content Patcher to add more options to the farm cave setup event with Demetrius.

There is also a config option to reset the cave and have Demetrius ask you again which setup you would like.

[b]Warning: Resetting the cave layout after previously choosing one with this mod removes all objects previously placed in the cave in order to setup for a new cave type.[/b]

Mods that use this framework:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13922/]Bats and Mushrooms Farm Cave[/url]﻿

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10568]Lumisteria FCF Artifact Field[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10508/]Meat Vat Farm Cave[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10566/]Mineral Duggy Farm Cave[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10550/]Pagan Bunny Farm Cave[/url]
[/list]
Let me know if you create a mod that uses this framework!


[b][size=5]Creating Custom Setups[/size][/b]

There are currently two types of setup, following the vanilla types:

[list=1]
[*]Fixed stations that produce items daily like the mushroom bins
[*]Random appearing items like bat fruit
[/list]
Note that this mod doesn't actually cause stations to produce items like the mushroom bins - I recommend using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10152]Custom Object Production[/url] mod to add station production.

Content Patcher format is as follows:

[code]{
    "Format": "1.23.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "farm_cave_choices",
            "Entries": {
                "MyFarmCave": {
                    "id": "MyFarmCave",
                    "choice": "My Thing",
                    "description":"I can set up machines in the cave to magically produce your thing.",
                    "objects": [
                        {
                            "id": "aedenthorn.MyThingDGA/My Thing Producer",
                            "X": 4,
                            "Y": 5
                        },
                        ...
                    ]
                },
                "AnotherThing": {
                    "id": "AnotherThing",
                    "choice": "Another Thing",
                    "description":"I can set up the cave to make another thing appear.",
                    "resourceChance": 66,
                    "resources": [
                        {
                            "id": "Another Thing",
                            "weight": 10
                        },
                        {
                            "id": "A Rare Thing",
                            "weight": 1
                        }
                        ...
                    ]
                }
            }
        }
    ]
}
[/code]
[b]objects[/b] is a list of stations, [b]resources[/b] is a list of random items that might drop. A setup can use both at once if desired. [b]resourceChance[/b] is out of 100 - the game will keep trying to add random resources to an empty tile until this chance fails.


Note: Animations (bat eyes, flying bats, etc.) and sounds (bat flap, screechs, etc.) are still a WIP

[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires SDV 1.5.5+

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
